Mens

Play your way to greatness in the bold colours of the Manchester United away kit for men. The 2026/27 jersey stands out with a royal blue base that's long been synonymous with our club's most iconic identities on the road.

The tonal stripe running through the fabric adds a sense of movement to the design, while the sleek red and white detailing around the collar and cuffs offers a sharp contrast. There's a potent mix of the classic and the contemporary, too, with the adidas Trefoil logo and Climacool technology that keeps you laser-focused on the action.

Put on the Man Utd men's away shirt and the impact will be twofold. Not only will you fly the club colours; you'll make a confident statement. Order yours today and get ready to follow the team – wherever they go, and wherever you are.
